Bea Morgan: heads-up I opened a tiny PR to fix examples and a dead schema link in function-calling docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4912
Ishaan Rao: Thanks Bea. Which examples are failing snippet-ci?
Bea Morgan: The JS compact-envelope example and one python snippet that had no language fence. CI flagged extraction errors.
Tori Lane: I can take the JS one. Do we want to prefer explicit {"action":...,"args":...} in the main body and put compact envelope as an "Advanced" note?
Bea Morgan: Yes. Keep main examples human-readable. Add the compact envelope under an Advanced collapsed panel and link to schema defs instead of copying them.
Ishaan Rao: Also add a short "If the model returns non-JSON" section with this minimal Python fallback (try json.loads -> if fail, extract first balanced braces). Keep helper tiny and link to gist.
Tori Lane: Pushed JS fix: explicit action/args in examples, moved compact envelope to Advanced, updated the broken anchor to /docs/schema-toolcall.md.
docs-bot: snippet-ci commented on PR #4912  python-snippets: 0 failed, js-snippets: 0 failed.
Bea Morgan: awesome; I'll merge after a quick smoke run and add a changelog line. If anything regresses, ping me and I'll revert. :tada:
